request.description: Original Pulp Wars chunky clean 2D strategy-game illustration, playful board-game sticker, strong dark colored outline, mostly flat colors, two-level cel shading, minimal texture, simple highlight, intentionally drawn rather than rendered, charming silly adventurous tone.
